regime.summary: Policy rate held at 22.0% while CPI fell to 11.74% from 23.07% three months earlier, so real rates are positive and the bill market prices cuts the SBP has not made. Index already up 77% in 12m, so the easy part is behind; base rates for a first cut and for MPC holds are positive but weak and thin. Moderate net long, no leverage.

core.thesis: Fertilizer sector is up strongly over 3m and 6m; EFERT trades on a low P/E with a high dividend yield, which pays while waiting for rate cuts. Base rates give no proven edge to quality or momentum, so size is modest.

Very low P/E and a 43% dividend yield on the screen, price within 2% of its 252-day high so the market is not ignoring it. Power sector is the only one with a name near highs and positive 1m return. Modest size given weak evidence for any single-name rule.

Islamic bank with EPS up year on year, low P/E, double-digit yield. Islamic banks sector is up over 6m. Foreign flows into commercial banks over 20 sessions are positive, while individuals sell. Cuts would help bank-linked sentiment but margins are a risk I cannot size from this pack.
